name: Cartomancy
body:
School divination; Level bard 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S, F (1 deck of cards)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You place out the cards to gain the benefits of the augury spell.
